layout.guidance: Pair concise editorial context with open record fields and keep every caption, state, and action attached to its object.

mobile.guidance: Stack records in source order and place each caption immediately after its object.

tablet.guidance: Pair context with one featured record only when both retain a useful reading measure.

desktop.guidance: Use the twelve column field for editorial context, featured records, and a sparse supporting register.

zoom.guidance: Let headings, captions, filters, and actions wrap without clipping or separating from their records.

reflow.guidance: Convert every collection to one complete vertical register without losing metadata or actions.

square.usage: Hairline registers, tables, and structural collection boundaries.

control.usage: Buttons, fields, menus, and compact interactive surfaces.

panel.usage: Dialogs and bounded reading surfaces that require separation.

hairline.usage: Captions, collection registers, and internal table groups.

default.usage: Controls, cards, and ordinary working boundaries.

strong.usage: Focus, current selection, and consequential separation.

flat.usage: Default records and surfaces organized by space and rules.

raised.usage: Movable records and temporary emphasis within a working collection.

overlay.usage: Dialogs, menus, and temporary content above the collection.

buttons.guidance: Use one filled primary action per decision region and keep secondary actions defined but quiet.

states.default: Use the primary cue with a stable result focused label.
states.hover: Deepen the cue without changing size or position.
states.focus: Show the semantic focus ring outside the control boundary.
states.active: Move by at most one pixel and preserve nearby layout.
states.disabled: Keep the action readable and expose the missing prerequisite.
states.loading: Retain the action label beside a visible progress indicator.
states.success: Name the completed result with text and the success role.
states.error: Name the failed operation and its recovery using the destructive role.

links.guidance: Use specific destinations, persistent underlines, and the primary cue only for actionable text.

states.default: Underline the destination and use the accessible primary role.
states.hover: Strengthen the underline without changing line height.
states.focus: Frame the link with the same semantic focus ring as controls.
states.active: Retain the destination while showing immediate activation.
states.disabled: Render unavailable destinations as explained text instead of links.
states.loading: Keep the destination label and add adjacent busy status.
states.success: Confirm the local navigation result in nearby text.
states.error: Explain the local failure without relying on color.

forms.guidance: Group fields around the record they describe, keep help persistent, and place validation in the same reading path.
forms.help: This description appears with the record wherever it is listed.

inputs.textareaPlaceholder: Explain why this record belongs in the collection.
inputs.guidance: Keep labels visible, align fields to the reading register, and reserve stable space for help and validation.

cards.title: Field note 24
cards.description: A featured record keeps its context, provenance, state, and next action together.
cards.guidance: Use a card only when a record needs an independent action or background; ordinary specimens stay in the open field.

panels.title: Collection register
panels.description: The register keeps featured, recent, and unresolved records understandable without nesting every item.
panels.guidance: Use one rule and aligned captions instead of separate containers for every register item.

navigation.label: Collection sections
navigation.guidance: Name the current section in text, preserve reading order, and keep every destination reachable by keyboard.

listItems.title: Featured
listItems.description: The lead record has complete context.

listItems.title: Unresolved
listItems.description: One record needs a source note.

dataDisplay.guidance: Keep record title, type, provenance, freshness, and actions aligned in one readable register.
dataDisplay.overflowGuidance: Preserve the complete comparison in a labelled keyboard reachable scroll region when priority columns cannot fit.

badges.label: Draft
badges.meaning: The record remains editable and unpublished

badges.label: In review
badges.meaning: The record is being checked for completeness

badges.label: Ready
badges.meaning: The record has a verified complete result

alerts.title: Collection ready to archive
alerts.description: Every required record has complete context.

alerts.title: Source note required
alerts.description: Add the missing context before archiving this record.

states.loading: Preparing the collection without hiding available records…
states.empty: This collection has no records yet.
states.filteredEmpty: No records match the active type and date filters.
states.error: The collection could not refresh. Existing records remain available.
states.success: The record is complete and ready for the collection.
states.disabled: Archiving remains unavailable until every required record has context.
states.destructive: Removing this collection also removes its unpublished notes.

feedback.guidance: Attach state to the affected record, preserve existing context, and include the next useful recovery.
feedback.nonColorGuidance: Pair every status color with a label, icon, boundary, or explicit state text.

dialogs.title: Confirm record publication
dialogs.description: Review the title, collection, visibility, and included context before continuing.
dialogs.guidance: Keep the record summary concise, place safe review first, and preserve the originating context.
dialogs.escapeBehavior: Escape closes the dialog because publication does not occur until confirmation.
dialogs.focusRestoration: Return focus to the publication control that opened the dialog.

destructiveActions.consequence: Unpublished records and their context notes will be removed.
destructiveActions.recoverability: This preview action is reversible and changes only local specimen state.
destructiveActions.guidance: Repeat the collection name, consequence, and real recovery status before the destructive boundary.

motion.guidance: Preserve the relationship between a record and its caption with short direct transitions and no ambient motion.

reducedMotion.guidance: Remove translation, scaling, smooth scrolling, and loops while preserving immediate labelled collection changes.

accessibility.semantics: Use native landmarks, headings, controls, tables, lists, figures, and status regions before adding ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Keep collection navigation, filters, record actions, overflow regions, menus, and dialogs fully operable in logical source order.
accessibility.focus: Use a persistent two pixel focus indicator and restore focus after every modal interaction.
accessibility.contrast: Measure text, controls, rules, status, and focus in both supported color schemes.
accessibility.targetSize: Provide targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels with adequate spacing and prefer 44 pixels for primary touch actions.
accessibility.zoom: Preserve every caption, label, filter, and action at 200 percent page zoom and 400 percent browser zoom.
accessibility.reflow: Reflow the collection to 320 CSS pixels without two dimensional page scrolling.
accessibility.forcedColors: Retain rules, current selection, focus, and feedback when system colors replace authored colors.
accessibility.statusCommunication: Announce asynchronous outcomes intentionally and never rely on color, position, or motion alone.

productSurfaces.guidance: These specimens demonstrate Cabinet structure only. Replace illustrative words with supplied Project language and preserve every real workflow rule.
